definition.title: Plan a customer referral experiment
definition.description: Use paying-customer tenure and the business economics available to set a cautious referral-reward ceiling, then prepare a page concept and customer email for the founder to review.

human_review.summary: Review the selected customer candidates, reward economics and draft copy before contacting anyone or publishing a referral page.

prerequisites.reason: Use the business and audience context, and check the owner's hard no's before inviting customers.
Use the captured writing style for the customer email when available.

product_summary.title: What the product does (optional)
product_summary.description: Use a sentence from the Feature map or README when project context is missing.

arpu.title: Monthly revenue per customer (optional override)
arpu.description: Use when Stripe is unavailable or its listed recurring prices do not reflect collected net revenue. Supply currency too.

currency.title: Currency for fallback ARPU and CAC
currency.description: Three-letter code such as USD. Required when fallback ARPU is used.

gross_margin_percent.title: Gross margin (%)
gross_margin_percent.description: Use the business's current gross margin. Stripe does not contain delivery costs.

monthly_churn_percent.title: Monthly customer churn (%)
monthly_churn_percent.description: Use a measured monthly rate when available; Stripe subscription status alone is not treated as a churn rate.

current_cac.title: Current acquisition cost per customer (optional)
current_cac.description: If known, enter the current CAC in the same currency as ARPU. It caps the reward-cost comparison.

allowed_ltv_percent.title: Share of gross-profit LTV available for acquisition (%)
allowed_ltv_percent.description: Conservative default: 30%. Adjust to the portion of gross-profit LTV the business permits for acquiring a customer.

minimum_paid_days.title: Minimum paid tenure for a referrer candidate (days)
